types.description: Mechanical interlock for two horizontally mounted LC1-F115 or LC1-F150 contactors

document.title: The essential guide of Automation & Control 2010
document.revision: DIA1ED2040506EN; 02/2010 V7.0; manufacturer-authored catalog at Unis Group mirror

modelingNotes: Exact historical LA9-FF970 rows identify the mechanical interlock for two identical horizontal LC1-F115 or LC1-F150 contactors. Separate power connection sets and host terminals are excluded.

Later Schneider LA9FF970 datasheet (13 Sep 2019, p.1) identifies a mechanical accessory; Digest Plus places LA9FF970 in the column without electrical interlock. Later unhyphenated spelling is interpreted as catalog formatting, not a successor substitution.
Zero documented electrical terminals and fixed links. Attachment metalwork, any PE/bond interface, and historical assembly-kit contents are not fully specified; no bonding continuity is inferred.
Accessory documentation view only. Mechanical interlocking behavior is descriptive and is not electrically simulated. No host contact, coil, rating, or circuit symbol is transferred.

connectionCoverage.notes: Mechanical accessory with zero documented electrical terminals. Reviewed sources do not specify conductive attachment or PE/bond interfaces; empty inventory is not proof of exhaustive electrical isolation. Host and separately ordered electrical interlock/power-link connections are outside scope.
